verdict.rationale: Release health is a fair question for an error-tracking and monitoring platform like Honeybadger, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows deployment tracking: recording deploys, diffing against the last deploy, auto-resolving errors, and filtering errors since the last deploy. That is adjacent to the story, but there is no documented crash-free session or user metric, no per-release adoption view, and no canary-versus-stable comparison.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can watch release health — crash-free sessions and users, adoption per release — and compare a canary release against the last stable one
